from io import BytesIO import json from pathlib import Path import sys import pymupdf import reportlab from reportlab.lib.styles import ParagraphStyle from reportlab.platypus import SimpleDocTemplate, Table, Paragraph, Spacer import aspose.words_foss as aw from aspose.words_foss import light_document_model as ldm from aspose.words_foss.docx_writer import LdmDocxWriter def para(text, **formatting): return ldm.Paragraph(children=[ldm.Run(text=text, font=ldm.Font(size=10))], paragraph_format=ldm.ParagraphFormat(**formatting)) def inspect(raw, headers, tokens): with pymupdf.open(stream=raw, filetype='pdf') as pdf: pages = [{'words': page.get_text('words'), 'text': page.get_text(), 'renderable': bool(page.get_pixmap().samples)} for page in pdf] text = ''.join(page['text'] for page in pages) assert all(text.count(token) == 1 for token in tokens) assert all(19 <= word[1] < word[3] <= 181 for page in pages for word in page['words']) complete = all(all(header in page['text'] for header in headers) for page in pages if any(header in page['text'] for header in headers)) return {'pages': pages, 'every_payload_once': True, 'headers_complete_on_every_appearance': complete} style = ParagraphStyle('cell', fontName='Helvetica', fontSize=10, leading=14, spaceBefore=0, spaceAfter=0) results = {'aspose_import': aw.__file__, 'reportlab_version': reportlab.Version, 'cases': {}, 'probe_source': Path(__file__).read_text()} for name, prefix, counts, cant_split in [('partial-first-header', True, [1], False), ('long-row', False, [40], False), ('many-rows', False, [1] * 30, False), ('intact-row', True, [5], True)]: headers = ['HEADER0', 'HEADER1', 'HEADER2'] payload = [[f'ROW{r:02}LINE{i:02}' for i in range(count)] for r, count in enumerate(counts)] rows = [ldm.Row(cells=[ldm.Cell(paragraphs=[para(text)])], row_format=ldm.RowFormat(heading_format=True)) for text in headers] rows += [ldm.Row(cells=[ldm.Cell(paragraphs=[para('\n'.join(lines))])], row_format=ldm.RowFormat(allow_break_across_pages=not cant_split)) for lines in payload] table = ldm.Table(rows=rows) children = ([para('PREFIX', space_after=120)] if prefix else []) + [table] model = ldm.Document(sections=[ldm.Section(page_setup=ldm.PageSetup(page_width=300, page_height=200, left_margin=20, right_margin=20, top_margin=20, bottom_margin=20), body=ldm.Body(children=children))]) docx = LdmDocxWriter().write_to_bytes(model) document = aw.Document(BytesIO(docx)) raw = document.to_bytes('pdf') output = BytesIO() story = ([Paragraph('PREFIX', style), Spacer(1, 120)] if prefix else []) data = [[Paragraph(text, style)] for text in headers] + [[Paragraph('
'.join(lines), style)] for lines in payload] story += [Table(data, colWidths=[260], repeatRows=3, splitByRow=1, splitInRow=0 if cant_split else 1, style=[('TOPPADDING', (0, 0), (-1, -1), 1.42), ('BOTTOMPADDING', (0, 0), (-1, -1), 1.42), ('VALIGN', (0, 0), (-1, -1), 'TOP')])] SimpleDocTemplate(output, pagesize=(300, 200), topMargin=20, bottomMargin=20, leftMargin=20, rightMargin=20, allowSplitting=1).build(story) tokens = sum(payload, []) results['cases'][name] = {'input_docx_bytes': len(docx), 'aspose': inspect(raw, headers, tokens), 'reportlab': inspect(output.getvalue(), headers, tokens)} if name == 'partial-first-header': with pymupdf.open(stream=raw, filetype='pdf') as pdf: pdf[1].get_pixmap(matrix=pymupdf.Matrix(2, 2)).save(f'/tmp/docweave-table-{sys.argv[1]}-page2.png') Path(f'/tmp/docweave-table-{sys.argv[1]}.json').write_text(json.dumps(results, indent=2) + '\n') print(json.dumps({name: {tool: {'pages':len(case[tool]['pages']), 'complete_headers':case[tool]['headers_complete_on_every_appearance']} for tool in ['aspose', 'reportlab']} for name, case in results['cases'].items()}))
